description: Find playable launch-video references and current remake workflows from the live Serena Launch.

interface.defaultPrompt: Find launch-video references for my product and help me remake one.
interface.longDescription: Find launch-video references for your next product launch. Search Serena Tan's curated collection by keywords, visual style, category and aspect ratio, inspect original source links and dated engagement snapshots, and get a concise reference-remake prompt. Every tool reads the current published collection. This read-only connector supplies references and planning metadata; it does not render videos, modify the collection or post to social platforms.
